title: Guinness Beer Cheese Dip
description: This savory beer cheese dip made with Velveeta and flavored with salsa, stout beer, chili, and cayenne is a superb spicy warm dip perfect for parties.
ingredients: 32 ounces processed cheese food (such as Velveeta®), cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 cup Irish stout beer (such as Guinness®)

steps.text: Heat cheese in slow cooker on High until melted, about 20 minutes.
Stir beer, salsa, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper into cheese until smooth and heated through, stirring frequently, about 10 minutes.

video.description: If you’re fan of beer cheese soup, grab a tortilla chip, a pretzel or a hunk of sourdough and dip into this tasty crowd-calling showstopper!  Preparation couldn’t be easier, so if you’re invited to the party last-minute, you’ll still arrive as the star. Begin by melting cheese in the slow cooker, then stir in Irish stout beer, salsa, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, onion powder and cayenne. Every cheesy bite will zing with peppery flavor!
